install.notes: setup.py declares python_requires >=3.10 and installs psutil, onnxscript and wandb>=0.19 (setup.py:12-19 and :39). The environment itself needs an Isaac Sim 4.5.0 / Isaac Lab 2.1.0 Linux install (README.md:3-6 and :32-34), the Unitree description archive fetched from GCS (README.md:46-55) and a motion NPZ assigned to the command term (commands.py:357-361); the gate and the fake backend need none of them, and the upstream package was not installed or imported here.
